scope: Native global Search redesign from the user-supplied date-column concept
implemented: Fresh toolbar, Command K, global shortcut and Projects entries search all saved DaBin content; same-session refinements persist.
One search field, one optional Filters popover, removable project/type/source/date chips and Clear filters.
Empty-query browsing and unified captures/tasks/local indexed text/snippet aliases/checklists/comments/project notes.
Newest matching saved dates and captures first; notes explicitly use edited dates; compact date paging covers the full archive.
One, two or three date columns; compact details and wide previews; query, date anchor, per-column scroll and capture destination preserved.
Existing copy/open/contextual actions and native drag providers; nearby captures are contextual and excluded from match counts.
Local indexing progress/unavailable feedback; tested 320-point minimum width and bounded long titles.

architecture.state: AppState search session and cached search presentation; no capture migration.
architecture.grouping: SearchDateBoard is a pure presentation model shared by logic tests and native UI.
architecture.presentation: SwiftUI native List per visible date, shared AppKit viewport helpers, existing Explorer inspector and note editor.
architecture.privacy: Fictional temporary archives and generated fixture pixels; no personal archive, external content, network or system clipboard needed by QA.

remainingLimitations: Strict desktop focus could not be obtained. HeaderInteractionTests failed its immediate search-focus assertion; native Search keyboard checks were explicitly skipped. Tab, Escape and end-to-end VoiceOver need desktop verification.

The 2000-item single-day stress scenario completes all viewport and restoration assertions but emits three AppKit NSTableView reentrant warnings. Initial large-day mounting took about 2.2 seconds and the deep Back flow about 7.2 seconds including test settling. Cause is unresolved; investigate before a performance-gated release.

Removing redundant Button focusable modifiers in a separate probe preserved 97 passing checks but did not remove warnings or improve timing. The experiment was rejected; it was not applied to live source.
Search covers DaBin-managed saved metadata and supported local extraction, not the whole Mac, semantic matching, or audio/video transcription.
Native renders and tests are developer verification on this ARM64 Mac; no recruited usability study, other OS versions or multi-display manual run was performed in this search task.

sourceProvenance.note: Independent work changed Projects tests and whitespace formatting during this task. Search QA used a frozen source tree. The sole production-source difference is whitespace-only in ProjectWorkspaceView.swift.
